summary: This is a documentation/registry-only update (ai-os/20_ENGINES_10_GATEWAYS_PHASE_PLAN_2026-07-24.yaml and ai-os/MASTER_INDEX.yaml) that corrects a stale status field and appends new reverification notes and four new registries[] entries describing the state of other in-flight PRs; it touches no code, no .github/workflows/** files, and no tier2-triggering paths (migrations, schema, *.sql, auth/, permission/payment/billing/rls/security, .env). Both YAML files parse cleanly after the change. I independently verified the diff's central factual claims against live repo state rather than trusting the self-report: all 10 cited phase/gateway commit hashes (b02d23e, 74b78ff, 9b6bddd, a53e924, 9e045c2, 2df7dea, 64471f2, 19e9c1d, 44ba0d5, 06a7e46) exist and are confirmed ancestors of origin/master, and the cited PR states match GitHub exactly (PR #84 merged, #82/#83 open+mergeable, #79/#80 open+CONFLICTING). The task correctly avoided editing the engine_inventory/gateway_inventory/meta blocks that a parallel still-open PR #83 touches, appending a cross-referencing section instead to avoid a collision, and appropriately declined to fix an unrelated PR's commit-message citation since that PR is out of this task's scope. No new build, no security-sensitive surface, no workflow-file changes.
